reasoning: By the Pigeonhole Principle, it is impossible to place 15 pigeons into 14 holes such that each hole contains at most one pigeon. With 14 holes each holding at most 1 pigeon, the maximum capacity is 14 pigeons — one short of the required 15. At least two pigeons would be forced to share a hole, violating the constraint. The problem is UNSATISFIABLE.
